text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Toronto and East York Community Council to extend the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Castle View Avenue, between Spadina Road and Walmer Road, from 2:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., and 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m., 7 days a week and extend the one hour parking maximum to include one hour parking at all other times. By extending the overnight on-street permit parking hours and introducing one hour parking at all other times, residents will have improved parking flexibility and the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, can effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Castle View Avenue, between Spadina Road and Walmer Road from 2:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., and 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m., 7 days a week. 2. Amended the existing maximum one hour parking limit in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, on the north side of Castle View Avenue, between Spadina Road and Walmer Road, to be in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., and from 8:00 p.m. to 12:01 a.m., daily.
